title: Page 9
content_zh:
哼，这一年多里他都不知道搂过多少女人，摸过她们的脸、胸、臀了……
“可是我现在只想碰你一个，老婆……”他又赖到她身上，撒娇地轻唤她的名，一踏进家门就逗她玩得很开心，抱她抱得很舒服……
天下女人何其多，但是老婆只有她一个……他可是碰得爱不释手呢！
“老婆再娶就有啦！”她仍旧没什么表情，但手却已不再推开他的怀抱。
“啊～～好香好浓的醋。”他故意用力吸了一口气，真难得从她身上嗅到吃醋的味道，当然要好好珍惜。
“你鼻子有问题。”她瞅他一眼，冷冷地说。
“我不是鼻子有问题，是眼睛有问题。”他更正她的话。
“为什么？”自大的人说自己有问题，听起来还真的很有问题。
“我居然没有早点看出来你喜欢我，还做了那么多让你难过的事，害你一个人伤心了那么久……对不起。”他紧抱住她，诚心地向她赔罪，很抱歉他那么迟钝的直到最近才领悟到自己对她的感情，这一年多来又赌气地做了那么多惹她伤心的事。
由他看到那个姓陈的家伙靠近她就觉得很不爽的这点推测，可想而知她这一年多来看到他绯闻满天飞会是什么心情，他光是用想的心就好痛。
她为什么要这么逞强，居然可以在他面前伪装这么久，害他现在好自责。
“真的对不起……”他贴着她的脸，在她耳边不断低诉自己的歉意。
她听着这个自大狂的道歉，唇角微微地向上弯起，伸手轻轻地回抱住他，倚偎向他暖热的怀里。
不知为何在这一刻，她的脑袋变得好空、好轻，好像突然想不太起来过去那些为他伤心难过的事情，甚至连方才那场激动得大哭也变得有点模糊……
可恶，她应该要好好跟他计较一番的，可是她现在又没脾气可发。
“反正我早就知道你不是个好人。”结果，她只轻哼了一声，说了这句话。
他轻笑着，稍微松开怀里力道，凝视着她成熟大方、心很宽的妻子，真怕她哪天会抛下他这个丈夫出家去修行……
“不行，你不要轻易原谅我，还是惩罚我一下好了，不然我会良心不安。”
她微地挑眉，杏眼圆睁地看着他，发现这男人突然变得这么谦虚，还真让人不太习惯哩！
“好，那就罚你……”既然他诚心悔过要受罚，她就认真地想想有什么方法可以处罚他，好让他的良心好过一点。

“不用想了，我已经帮你想好了。”他表情严肃地说。
“是什么？”
“就罚我今晚不准睡。”
“不准睡？”不睡要干么？
“对，让我用整夜的时间来弥补你所遭受的伤害，温暖你的心……”他吻住她的小嘴，双手抚上她曼妙的身子……
“这算什么惩罚！”她脸红地推开他的脸，心想这是罚他还是罚她？这个无赖！
“这是最严厉的惩罚，严重考验着一个男人的体力和耐力。”他凝重地说，嘴角却无耻地上扬着。
“不必，我原谅你，你把体力留着明天上班就好了。”她断然拒绝，明天还要上班呢！
“哦，这是我的一番心意，你就收下吧，老婆……”他将她扑倒在身下，开始拉扯她蔽体的被子，开始跟她“赔罪”……
“杜天海！”她死命抓着胸口的被子。
“来嘛，别跟我客气。”他使劲抽掉她的被子。
“你……”她来不及骂人，声音便已消失在他唇下，被堵得不留一丝缝隙，一下子便被他火热的唇舌吻得目眩神迷、六神无主……
说到底，他这个人就是嚣张成性，连道歉也不准人拒绝。
“对不起，老婆……”
夜愈深，他向妻子“赔罪”得愈来愈有诚意。
“别……别说了……”他愈道歉，她就觉得自己体力和耐力愈来愈受考验……
今晚，窗外的月色半掩，月光迷蒙得照不清房内的暧昧。恐怕得等到明日破晓后才能分辨得出，究竟是谁在惩罚谁，谁在考验谁……

翌日，杜天海起床发现妻子不在身边。他披着睡袍，寻着一阵咖啡香味找到饭厅里，看到妻子已经换上套装，妆扮整齐地坐在餐桌前吃早餐。
“早安，老婆。”他慵懒地一笑，微乱的发丝和半敝的领口让他显得有些轻狂，又带着几分阳刚的性感。

“早。”她抬眸看了他一眼，双颊微晕淡红，轻冒热气。

“我还以为你今天会唾过头呢！”他拉开椅子坐在她身边，凝视她含羞带怯的娇容，心头好像吹过一阵春风似的，不自禁地张臂将她揽进怀中，要抱抱这个惹人爱的小女人，回味一下她在怀里的美好感觉……
昨夜——不对，是今天凌晨看到她在床上已经累得睁不开眼，他才放她去会周公，没想到她今早还是那么早起床，早知道就应该再玩久一点，不让她睡了。
“放开，别弄绉我的衣服。”她推开他缠人的拥抱和乱摸一通的贼手，拉整身上平顺的衬衫，不想待会儿又要花时间重新整理一遍仪容。
“我还比不上一件衣服重要吗？”他马上不平衡地说，没想到自己深情款款的拥抱会输给一件死板板的衬衫，好歹他是有温度的。
她轻瞅他一眼，觉得他真是有点好笑，怎么会拿自己跟一件衣服比较，层次根本差很多！
“我只是不想再整理一次衣服，免得待会儿上班迟到。”见他一脸委屈又不满的表情，她只好解释一下。不过说起来真正应该发脾气的人是她吧，她都还没跟他计较昨晚害她睡眠不足的事呢……
拜他所赐，她这几天的睡眠习惯都被打乱，昨夜也是没睡多久又莫名其妙地醒来，睁开眼后便再也睡不着，在床上躺了一会儿便起床做早餐、煮咖啡了。
“迟到也是人生的一部分。”听妻子这么说，他心里舒坦多了，随即扬起了一抹悠哉的笑容。
她又瞟了他一眼，觉得自己要是像他这样随兴的过人生，公司肯定完蛋！
她对他松散的人生观不予置评，动手帮他倒了杯咖啡。
“要吃早餐吗？”她顺口问。因为只简单的烤了吐司、煎了蛋，再做了点生菜沙拉，所以不确定他会不会想吃。
“你做的？”他瞄了眼桌上的食物。
“不然呢？”家里还有别人吗？
“去对面拿就有了。”他接得很顺，好像对面的大门
“你以后不要一大早就跑去烦人家。”她郑重提醒他别再做这种打劫食物的事，害她见到大哥、大嫂很尴尬。
“我没有烦他们，我拿了早餐就走了。”他还很有脸说，觉得自己并没有留下来叨扰别人，只是端个早餐回来而已。
“总之别再去了，吃吧。”她用吐司夹好蛋给他。
“啊～～”他张大嘴巴。

“干么？”她皱眉不解。
“喂我。”他撒娇地靠向她，仰头张大嘴的模样活像只海洋公园里要人打赏食物的海狮。
“你今年几岁？”她没好气地问，暗讽他又不是小孩子，还要人喂咧。
“三岁。”他大言不惭地答。
她噗哧而笑，一脸受不了的表情，觉得他还真敢讲，起码有三岁的十倍了好不好！
“自己吃。”她把吐司放到他手里，才不理他幼稚的行为。
content_en:
Humph, he doesn’t know how many women he has hugged and touched their faces, breasts, and buttocks in the past year or so...
"But I just want to touch you now, my wife..." He leaned on her again, calling her name coquettishly, teasing her to have a good time as soon as he stepped into the house, and hugging her very comfortably...
There are so many women in the world, but she is the only wife... He is so in love with her that he can't put it down!
"My wife can marry me again!" She still had no expression, but her hands no longer pushed away his arms.
"Ah~~The vinegar smells so good." He took a deep breath deliberately. It was rare to smell jealousy from her, so of course he had to cherish it.
"There's something wrong with your nose." She glanced at him and said coldly.
"I don't have a problem with my nose, I have a problem with my eyes." He corrected her.
"Why?" When an arrogant person says he has a problem, it sounds like he has a problem.
"I didn't see earlier that you liked me, and I did so many things that made you sad, and made you sad for so long...I'm sorry." He hugged her tightly and apologized to her sincerely. He was sorry that he was so slow and didn't realize his feelings for her until recently, and he did so many things in anger to make her sad in the past year.
Judging from the fact that he felt very unhappy when he saw the guy named Chen approaching her, one can imagine how she felt when she saw the scandals flying around him for more than a year. His heart ached just thinking about it.
Why was she so brave? She could pretend to be in front of him for so long, which made him feel guilty now.
"I'm really sorry..." He leaned against her face and kept whispering his apologies in her ear.
Listening to this arrogant apology, she slightly curved the corners of her lips upwards, reached out and gently hugged him back, leaning into his warm arms.
For some reason, at this moment, her head became so empty and light, as if she suddenly couldn't remember all the things that made her sad for him in the past, and even the excitement she cried just now became a little blurry...
Damn it, she should have argued with him, but she had no temper to lose now.
"Anyway, I've known for a long time that you're not a good person." In the end, she just snorted and said this.
He chuckled, loosening his arms a little, and stared at her mature, generous, and generous wife. He was really afraid that one day she would abandon him as her husband and become a monk to practice spiritual practice...
"No, don't forgive me easily. It's better to punish me, otherwise I will have uneasy conscience."
She raised her eyebrows slightly and looked at him with wide almond-shaped eyes. She found that this man suddenly became so humble, which was really unaccustomed to her!
"Okay, then I'll punish you..." Since he sincerely repented and wanted to be punished, she seriously thought about how she could punish him to make his conscience feel better.
"No need to think about it, I've already thought about it for you." He said with a serious expression.
"What is it?"
"Just punish me by not sleeping tonight."
"No sleep allowed?" What are you going to do if you don't sleep?
"Yes, let me spend the whole night to make up for the harm you have suffered and warm your heart..." He kissed her mouth and touched her graceful body with both hands...
"What kind of punishment is this!" She blushed and pushed his face away, wondering if this was a punishment for him or her? This scoundrel!
"This is the most severe punishment, which seriously tests a man's physical strength and endurance." He said solemnly, but the corners of his mouth were raised shamelessly.
"No, I forgive you. Just save your energy and go to work tomorrow." She flatly refused and had to go to work tomorrow!
"Oh, this is my wish, just accept it, wife..." He threw her down, started to pull the quilt covering her body, and began to "apologise" to her...
"Du Tianhai!" She clutched the quilt on her chest desperately.
"Come on, don't be polite to me." He pulled the quilt off her hard.
"You..." She didn't have time to curse, her voice was alreadyShe disappeared under his lips and was blocked without leaving any gap. She was kissed by his hot lips and tongue and was dazzled and confused...
After all, he is an arrogant person and won't even let anyone refuse him an apology.
"I'm sorry, wife..."
As the night went on, he became more and more sincere in his "apology" to his wife.
"Don't... stop talking..." The more he apologized, the more she felt her physical strength and endurance were being tested more and more...
Tonight, the moonlight outside the window is half-lit, and the moonlight is so hazy that it cannot illuminate the ambiguity in the room. I'm afraid we have to wait until dawn tomorrow to tell who is punishing whom, who is testing whom...

The next day, Du Tianhai got up and found that his wife was not around. He put on his nightgown and found the smell of coffee in the dining room. He saw his wife had changed into a suit and was sitting neatly at the dining table having breakfast.
"Good morning, wife." He smiled lazily. His slightly messy hair and half-ruined collar made him look a little frivolous, but also a little masculine and sexy.
"Morning." She raised her eyes and glanced at him, her cheeks slightly red and steaming.

"I thought you would spit on me today!" He pulled out the chair and sat next to her, gazing at her shy and delicate face. As if a spring breeze was blowing in his heart, he couldn't help but open his arms to take her into his arms, wanting to hug this cute little woman and savor the wonderful feeling of having her in his arms...
Last night - no, it was early this morning when he saw her too tired to open her eyes in bed, so he let her go to meet Duke Zhou. He didn't expect that she still got up so early this morning. If he had known better, he should have played longer and not let her sleep.
"Let go, don't crease my clothes." She pushed away his clinging embrace and groping hands, straightened her smooth shirt, not wanting to spend time rearranging her appearance later.
"Am I not more important than a piece of clothing?" He said unbalancedly immediately, not expecting that his affectionate hug would be lost to a rigid shirt. After all, he had warmth.
She glanced at him lightly and thought he was really funny. How could he compare herself with a piece of clothing? The level was so different!
"I just don't want to sort out my clothes again, so as not to be late for work later." Seeing his aggrieved and dissatisfied expression, she had no choice but to explain. But speaking of it, she is the one who should really lose her temper. She hasn't even bothered with him about the lack of sleep she had last night...
Thanks to him, her sleeping habits have been disrupted in the past few days. Last night, she woke up inexplicably after not sleeping for long. After opening her eyes, she couldn't fall back to sleep. She lay in bed for a while and then got up to make breakfast and make coffee.
"Being late is also a part of life." Hearing his wife say this, he felt much more comfortable, and then he smiled leisurely.
She glanced at him again, feeling that if she lived life as casually as he did, the company would definitely be doomed!
She made no comment about his loose outlook on life and moved to get him a cup of coffee.
"Want to have breakfast?" she asked smoothly. Because I simply toasted, fried eggs, and made some lettuce salad, I wasn’t sure if he would want to eat it.
"Did you make it?" He glanced at the food on the table.
"What else?" Is there anyone else at home?
"Go and get it from the opposite side." He answered it smoothly, just like the door opposite.
"Don't go bothering other people early in the morning." She solemnly reminded him not to do this kind of robbing food, which would make her embarrassed when she saw her elder brother and sister-in-law.
"I didn't bother them, I took breakfast and left." He said with dignity, feeling that he didn't stay to bother others, he just came back with breakfast.
"Anyway, don't go anymore, just eat." She put the eggs on toast and gave them to him.
"Ah~~" He opened his mouth wide.
"What?" She frowned in confusion.
"Feed me." HeHe leaned towards her coquettishly, raising his head and opening his mouth like a sea lion in Ocean Park asking for food.
"How old are you this year?" she asked angrily, implying that he was not a child and had to be fed.
"Three years old." He replied confidently.
She burst into laughter, with an expression that she couldn't stand it, thinking that he really dared to talk, at least ten times that of a three-year-old, okay?
"Eat it yourself." She put the toast into his hand and ignored his childish behavior.
